arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argued forum selection clauses are common in contracts. It urged the Court to enforce them as written.
the opposing side argued the case belongs in Texas. It noted the work, witnesses, and evidence are located there.
Justice Alito questioned the distinction between venue and jurisdiction. He cited a case where the court denied a motion to dismiss.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether a contract clause can force a lawsuit into a specific court. the side that brought the case argues the clause is binding. the opposing side argues the clause cannot override federal law.
